general.workspaceBody: How this workspace appears to its members.
general.name: Name
general.slugHint: Changing it breaks old links to this workspace.
general.timezoneHint: Posts are scheduled and shown in this time zone.
general.timezoneSearch: Search by city, country or offset
general.logoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, under 2 MB. Shown in the switcher and on invitations.

validation.slugInvalid: Use 3–48 lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens.

general.reviewBody: Contributors’ posts always need approval before they go out. Turn this on to have every post approved by someone other than its author.
general.reviewAll: Review every post before it goes out
general.reviewOn: Every post now needs approval before it goes out.
general.reviewOff: Only contributors’ posts need approval now.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.body: Only the owner can do these.
danger.transferBody: Make an admin the owner. You become an admin.
danger.transferDescription: The new owner gets full control, including deleting the workspace. You stay on as an admin.
danger.transferNone: Only admins can become owner. Make someone an admin in Members first.
danger.deleteBody: Deletes its posts, media and connected accounts for good after 30 days.
danger.deleteDescription: Members lose access at once, and scheduled posts are cancelled. Everything is permanently deleted after 30 days.

members.title: Members
members.removeDescription: They lose access to {{workspace}} at once. You can invite them again later.
members.leaveDescription: You lose access at once. An admin can invite you again.

invite.title: Invite to {{workspace}}
invite.description: We email them a link to join. It works for 7 days.
invite.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.revokeDescription: The link stops working. You can invite them again later.

roles.ownerAbout: Everything, including billing and deleting the workspace.
roles.adminAbout: Manages members, settings and connected accounts; publishes and approves.
roles.contributorAbout: Drafts posts and uploads media; an editor approves them.
roles.viewerAbout: Sees the calendar, posts and analytics; changes nothing.

access.title: Accounts {{name}} can use
access.description: They see and post to only these accounts: their posts, the calendar and the queue show nothing else.
access.allBody: Every account in the workspace, including ones connected later.
access.someBody: Pick the accounts. Accounts connected later aren't added.
access.noneWarning: With no accounts selected they can't see or post to any account.
access.adminHint: Owners and admins always have every account.
